Subject: Vendor activation: evidence needed for PO eligibility (DataWorks Inc.)

Hi Elena / DataWorks onboarding team,

Thanks for working with us on the setup for DW-4921. To get a PO in place and activate billing we need a few standard items from you:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached).
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing the following minimum limits and endorsements:
  - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
  - Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000
  - Cyber/Privacy Liability: $2,000,000 (if applicable to the services)
  - Additional insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents"
  - Primary and non-contributory wording and waiver of subrogation where allowed

- W-9 (we need taxpayer info to set up your vendor record)
- Invoice remit instructions and legal entity name for the PO.

If you can send the COI and W-9 as attachments, and indicate whether you can provide the additional insured endorsement as a separate endorsement (preferred), we can proceed. If the COI you provide already contains the exact endorsement language, please note that in your reply.

We typically issue Net-30 POs for new suppliers; confirm if DataWorks accepts Net-30 and the correct remit address. Once documents are verified Procurement will issue a conditional PO number and Finance will queue vendor setup.

Attached: Redwood_Onboarding_Form_2027-03-05.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Ben / Connor — saw Elena's reply and the attached COI/W-9. The COI as-is lists Redwood as a certificate holder but does not include the additional insured endorsement language we require. Procurement policy requires either: (A) the carrier issues an additional insured endorsement naming Redwood Inference, Inc. and primary/non-contributory language; or (B) Legal approves a risk exception (rare, and would require escalation).

Recommendations:
- Request the endorsement from DataWorks' broker (simple ask; vendor has indicated they will request).
- We can issue a conditional PO (PO pending endorsement) so the vendor can invoice once the endorsement is received — add an activation hold clause in the PO: "Activation of services and payment will be contingent on delivery of required insurance endorsements."
- I'll loop Legal if the broker cannot provide the endorsement within 7 business days.

Naomi — can you confirm vendor record creation steps once we have W-9 and endorsement? Also confirm whether Net-30 will be accepted in Finance.

Quoted for context: 
> The COI includes "Redwood Inference, Inc." as a certificate holder but the carrier did not issue an additional insured endorsement on the initial certificate.

Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena — really appreciate the quick turnaround with the COI and W-9. Per Procurement policy the endorsement is required for activation. We will take the following steps to keep things moving:

1) Redwood will issue a conditional PO number now (PO-2027-1193). That PO will include an activation hold clause: services are not active and invoices will not be paid until the additional insured endorsement is received and verified by Procurement.
2) Please ask your broker to send the additional insured endorsement naming: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents" and indicating primary and non-contributory coverage where allowed.
3) Once Procurement confirms receipt of the endorsement Finance will finalize vendor setup and remove the activation hold. Expect the formal PO (PO-2027-1193) to arrive via email after endorsement verification.

Remit details you sent (DataWorks Inc., 88 Via Roma, Milan) are fine; Naomi, please flag if we need additional vendor setup steps for an international remit.

Elena — send the endorsement to onboarding@redwood.ai and cc me; we'll confirm receipt within one business day.
